formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Sets the owner's FXRP allowance for `spender` to exactly `value`, replacing any earlier allowance (FAsset._approve -> ERC20._approve, called from ERC20Permit.permit).
The permit works only until `deadline` (require(block.timestamp <= deadline)) and uses up the owner's current permit nonce.
No tokens move when the permit is signed. The spender can later pull up to `value` FXRP from the owner with transferFrom.
formats.shown: "Authorize spending of tokens". The fields show the spender address (raw), the max spending amount in FXRP ("Unlimited" at or above 2^255), the expiry date and the owner.

findings.title: Permit intent names neither the token, the amount nor the spender; there is no interpolatedIntent.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json display.formats Permit: "intent": "Authorize spending of tokens", no interpolatedIntent. Cases 0 and 1 show the amount and spender only in the fields.
